settings.label: Place 1
settings.help: Home is the orb's own, set on the Orb tab. Up to three more places sit beside it: on the weather screen, a press steps from Home through them. The forecast comes from Open-Meteo, one request for every place.

settings.label: Clock
settings.help: A digital clock under the weather now, in the orb's time format; a place's own time on its page.
